derivation: The independent three-queue and four-queue control chains take 130 ns and 170 ns respectively. Their seven source queue cycles therefore provide one workload-independent queue-control primitive of (130 ns + 170 ns) / (3 + 4) = 42.857142857142854 ns.
source_counting_rule: Charge one cycle for every source AllocTensor/EnQue/DeQue/FreeTensor queue lifetime. RMSNorm has gamma once per worker, x and y once per row, and rstd once per row group. AddRMSNorm has gamma once per worker, x once per row, the shared y queue twice per row for residual and final output, and rstd once per row group.
